@graph.name: Provenance crate for 05_P05_S05_internal-format.schema.json (F11)
@graph.description: RO-Crate 1.1 documenting the regeneration of the EDO internal-format JSON Schema and the provenance of this version. The crate is fully self-contained: it contains COPIES of the two files that constitute the version (the generated JSON Schema and its LinkML source), everything needed to REPEAT the generation from the source alone (reproduce.sh, the pinned Python environment in environment/, and the linkml:types module resolved during the run), and SNAPSHOT COPIES under references/ of the repository files that shaped the version (specification, sibling source-side schemas, transformation patterns and LinkML Maps, the two realisations trip.py and agnostic_trip.py) — each snapshot records the git blob of the copied file. Documents (specification, trafos README, cards) that were not flagged as data entities remain as external CreativeWork references into the repository. Findings catalogue: ../trafos/README.md §13, F11. Refreshed 2026-11-22 for the funder/funding extension of the internal format (Project `edo:hasFunding` -> Funding/Funder, patterns P43–P47; see #gen-json-schema-run-20261122): all copies and snapshot copies updated to that state; the 2026-11-19 regeneration (after e7a8d20, superseding commit 09a25eb) remains documented in the entity descriptions and the CreateActions below.

Differences to the 2026-11-19 version (blob d768c94a65ca824260495f6f67c48ae8fd31d2cc): the funder/funding extension of the internal format — new classes Funding (`edo:Funding`) and Funder (`edo:Funder`), new Project slot `has_funding` (`edo:hasFunding`), new slots funder/grant_id/funding_status, and the `fundref` value in IdentifierTypeEnum (patterns P43–P47, see #gen-json-schema-run-20261122). The 2026-11-19 regeneration for F11 (with its own differences: CF2-004 reconciliation descriptions and the metamodel_version downgrade 1.12.0 -> 1.11.0 caused by the linkml 1.11.1 pinning, F8) remains described under #gen-json-schema-run-20261119T1834. Reproducible from the crate contents alone (reproduce.sh; verified byte-identical 2026-11-22 against the archived result).

@graph.name: Funder/funding extension of the internal format (schema + map + patterns, 2026-11-22)
@graph.description: Editing activity that extended the internal format with the funder/funding part: the maDMP source schema gained `dmp/funding` (Funding/Funder classes, `fundref` enum value — not yet exported by the maDMP plugin), the internal-format schema gained the Funding/Funder classes, the Project slot `has_funding` (`edo:hasFunding`), the slots funder/grant_id/funding_status and the `fundref` value, and the LinkML Map dmp-to-internal gained the derivations for patterns P43–P47 (catalogue ../trafos/patterns.md).
